# SALIENT FEATURES

Integrated connecting frame*with Bearing cover - **Reduce component & enhance reliability**

External Shim set arrangement for impeller clearance adjustment - **Restores pump efficiency**

Large oil sump with Oil mist / Oil bath lubrication - **Increases MTBF**

Graphite Impregnated PTFE / Single or Double Mechanical seal - **Environment Safety**

Bull nose type open impeller - **Low NPSH and avoids risk of clogging**

Accurately contoured Suction wear plate - **Prolonged wear life**
